description: Connections containing access tokens for the GitLab Platform
documentation: (for more information read the [GitLab API documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/rest/ "Visit GitLab document"))

name.description: A unique and clearly identifiable connection name to your GitLab instance.

constraints.customMessage: Name has to be between 1 and 50 characters long

url.description: The GitLab URL instance you want to connect. For example, https://gitlab.com

constraints.customMessage: URL has to be between 5 and 500 characters long

token.description: The GitLab token to use for authentication. Please note that this token is not refreshed and can expire.
token.documentation: GitLab token in the form of `******`. Not a secret for now due to problems retrieving it from the API functions

constraints.customMessage: Token has to be between 5 and 500 characters long
For security reasons please re-enter the API token before saving the configuration.

schemaConstraints.customMessage: A connection with the same name already exists. Please provide a different name.
